# `vis`

Generate UMAP/matrix/overlay/population visualization outputs

- Wrapper: [`job_visualisations.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_visualisations.sh)
- Conda environment: `imc_segmentation`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.basic_visualizations`

## Inputs

- visualization.input_adata_path or process.output_adata_path
- general.masks_folder, general.denoised_images_folder, general.metadata_folder

## Outputs

- outputs/<execution_id>_Visualisation/

## Configuration

- general, visualization, process, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl vis
```
